title: 第一卷 第11章 高能燃烧液体
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

偷袭什么的，还是木弓方便一点。

随后将昨天改造的那个木制长枪放在了一边。

在初级制造台上面开始制作铁质枪头。

一块铁就能够制造出一个不错的枪头。

铁质的，毕竟要比木制枪头更加耐用和锋利。

做好了枪头，装在木棍之上，简直是完美。

至于精铁什么的，等晚上回来再看看情况。

反正妖兽内丹这种东西，实在是难以得到。

也不着急升级木屋了。

带上长枪木弓，手握大威力左轮，秦龙准备出门收集物资了。

从窗户上面看去，外面的环境果然是已经变了。

昨天的那个地方，已经消失。

今天自己出现的地方，貌似是在一大片草地之上。

周围几乎看不到树。

远处有些小山脉上面，都是嶙峋怪石。

这样的地貌，天知道有什么，不过木板肯定是没有什么收获了。

升级五级木屋，还需要石头，或许在这里收集点石头也是不错的。

推门而出，迎面一股青草的气息扑面而来。

还真是一片大草地。

一览无余朝着前面延伸而去。

自己看到的那个小山，就在不远处，在这片草地之上，显得格外突兀。

忽然的丧尸叫声，将秦龙拉回了陶醉。

木屋的后面，一只口流脓水的丧尸，就这么看着秦龙。

这丧尸，有点不一样，看起来比昨天的那些丧尸稍微完整一点。

身上稍微有了一点皮肤的概念。

让秦龙不舒服的，是这个丧尸的脖子上面挂了一个破损的毯子。

这毯子，应该是龙国用来包裹婴儿的那种毯子。

此时出现了丧尸的脖子上，加上丧尸的变化。

秦龙有了某种猜测。

这只丧尸，在夜晚来临的时候，进入了那些被木屋，吃了毫无抵抗力的婴儿！

从而发生了这种变化！

如果真的是这样，那么以后遇见的丧尸，只会越来越强！

发出一声怒吼以后，丧尸快速的朝着自己扑乐了过来。

对于吃了婴儿的丧尸，秦龙有点发怒。

虽然这个婴儿不是自己的，但现在，手中的长枪在瞬间插进了丧尸的嘴巴当中。

Page (1/3)

For sneak attacks, a wooden bow is more convenient.

Then he put aside the wooden spear he had modified yesterday.

Start crafting the iron spear head on the primary manufacturing bench.

A good spear point can be made from a piece of iron.

After all, the iron tip is more durable and sharper than the wooden tip.

The gun head was made and mounted on the wooden stick. It was perfect.

As for the fine iron and so on, I’ll check the situation when I get back in the evening.

Anyway, things like the inner elixir of monsters are really hard to get.

There is no rush to upgrade the wooden house.

Armed with a long spear, a wooden bow, and a powerful revolver in his hand, Qin Long was ready to go out to collect supplies.

Looking from the window, the environment outside has indeed changed.

The place of yesterday has disappeared.

The place where I appeared today seemed to be on a large piece of grass.

There were almost no trees around.

There are some small mountains in the distance covered with jagged and strange rocks.

God knows what there is in such a landscape, but the planks are definitely not going to yield much.

To upgrade the fifth-level wooden house, you also need stones. Maybe it would be good to collect some stones here.

Pushing open the door, you are greeted by the smell of green grass.

It's really a big grassland.

The unobstructed view stretches forward.

The hill he saw was not far away, and it looked particularly abrupt on this grassland.

The sudden cry of zombies brought Qin Long out of intoxication.

Behind the wooden house, a zombie with pus oozing from its mouth looked at Qin Long.

This zombie is a little different. It looks a little more complete than the zombies from yesterday.

I have a little bit of the concept of skin on my body.

What made Qin Long uncomfortable was that there was a torn blanket hanging on the zombie's neck.

This blanket should be the kind used by Dragon Kingdom to wrap babies.

At this time, the zombie's neck appeared, plus the zombie's changes.

Qin Long had some speculation.

This zombie entered those wooden houses when night came and ate the defenseless babies!

Thus this change occurred!

If this is really the case, then the zombies you encounter in the future will only get stronger and stronger!

After letting out a roar, the zombie quickly rushed toward him.

Qin Long was a little angry at the zombie that ate the baby.

Although the baby was not his, the spear in his hand was inserted into the zombie's mouth in an instant.
